deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 for full consideration and funding; complete applications by January 15, 2027 may be considered but it is not guaranteed.
deadline.quote: Fall 2027 application deadline for full consideration and funding: December 1, 2026

gre_general.value: The GRE is optional for the PhD.

supervisor.value: You may contact faculty about their groups, but the research advisor is chosen during the fall of the first year.
supervisor.quote: You are welcome to contact CCB faculty to inquire about their research group. | The research advisor selection process takes place during the Fall semester of the first year.

funding.value: Accepted PhD students in good standing get full support (tuition, health insurance, monthly stipend) for five years, regardless of citizenship.
funding.quote: The chemistry department at Rutgers University provides full support (tuition, health insurance, and monthly stipend) to accepted PhD students in good academic standing for five years of study.

english_waiver.value: Exempt from TOEFL/IELTS/DET if you completed at least three years of undergraduate study (or two years of a master's) taught in English, with documentation or a Medium of Instruction certificate from your institution.
english_waiver.quote: International students who have completed a minimum of three years of undergraduate studies or two years in a master's program at an institution where the mode of instruction is English are exempt from submitting TOEFL, IELTS, or DET scores. | Applicants must provide documentation from the institution noting English instruction or provide a Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

entry_route.value: Not stated on the official pages checked.

notes: Department says it does not provide its own fee waiver.
